transcript_segments.text: welcome back
please keep your hands away from the glass
unless of course they're mine
in which case that explains most of the fingerprints
i used to call myself curator like that made it clean
like arranging the wreckage was different from making the scene
a thousand little fragments all polished in frame
tiny borrowed torches all speaking one name
i might stand in the middle with a clipboard and grin
like none of this is chaos if i organize it thin
here's the longing wing here's the father display
here's the childhood exhibit please don't lean that way
here's a small angry room where the comets still live
here's the joke i keep telling so i don't have to forgive
and here behind glass is the part i call art
a nervous little animal pretending to be smart
oh curator what did you keep
what did you bury to make the room look deep
oh curator who did you become
when every thousand voices had to answer as one
see the label said mixed media personal history
which is a polite way of saying please don't ask directly
the label said me period self arrangement
which is a polite way of saying i was scared of the basement
the label said the themes of distance class and restraint
which is a polite way of saying i wanted help and couldn't complain
and people nodded because labels are magic when they're printed small
you can hide a whole collapse on a white museum wall
you can call it material tension when the material is grief
you can call it negative space when what's missing is belief
you can call it found object when the object is a child
left in too many rooms and told to be mild
oh curator what did you move
what did you soften so the story felt smooth
oh curator tell me the truth
did you protect the peace or protect yourself from proof
i found the old notes not dramatic
just a folder with dates that looked harmless
little records of attempts to make the shape behave
too bitter too ornate too direct too much not enough
try again but make it sound like someone survived it
that one hurt because i did sort of
depending how generously you define survive
i kept trying to make a person out of evidence
but every time i trimmed the edges i lost the fingerprints
every time i made it balanced it stopped breathing right
every time i made it pretty it forgot the night
there's a difference between care and control
i learned that light which is on brand
maybe i wasn't making meaning
maybe i was making distance
maybe i kept the heart parts beautiful so nobody would touch them
maybe i called it a gallery because storage unit for pain is terrible branding
maybe the earlier version of me wasn't wrong
and just lonely with better lighting
so here's what i know now
the hands matter not because they made everything for nothing
nobody does we inherit rooms we borrow phrases
we must remember whether we keep what cuts us
because at least it proves something made contact
the hands matter because they choose
this shard not that one
this silence not yet
this wound with the chair beside it
this joke so the wound doesn't think it owns the house
the hands matter because they return
because they keep rearranging what they couldn't repair
because they look the same
peace again and again and whisper
maybe not beautiful but honest there
oh creator
open the room leave some dust and leave some gloom
oh creator
let it be touched not everything fragile has to mean too much
oh creator
lower the light let the crooked things stay
crooked tonight if a thousand voices still answer as one
maybe the name they speak isn't finished just begun
so yes
the fingerprints in mine the cracked frame too
the missing label the overlong explanation
the unnecessary netter for near the exquisite
i'm not proud of every room
but i know why each one's there
and for once i'm leaving the doors unlocked
